name: Nexus Glitched Code Dragon
text:
2 'Nexus' Monsters
If this card is sent to the GY by Opponent's card effect, you can Fusion Summon 1 'Nexus' Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck by banishing up to 2 'Nexus' monsters from your GY. Once Per Turn: You can target 1 'Nexus' Monster you control and 1 monster your Opponent controls. That Opponents monster loses ATK equal to half the targeted 'Nexus' Monsters ATK until the end of the Turn.
